podcast.body: This song became a top 10 hit, largely propelled by its "special effects heavy" music video. The video was so impactful that it surprisingly beat Michael Jackson's "Thriller" video for Video of the Year at the inaugural MTV Video Music Awards. "Their special effects heavy clip for You Might Think not only made that song a top 10 hit, the video upset Michael Jackson's Thriller for video of the year at the first MTV Video Music Awards."
